locator: Fig. 2A, filled symbols in the main panel
preparation: Human SLC5A8 expressed in a Xenopus oocyte under two-electrode voltage clamp. External sodium was 100 mM and pH was 7.5. The figure gives no numerical temperature.
mapping: Positive ordinate values are inward current magnitudes obtained by subtracting the substrate-free steady current at the same voltage. Fig. 2A is a representative oocyte. Three more oocytes were described as similar. The panel has no individual error bars. The point-reading precision is our estimate. The article gives 127 ± 14 µM for half-saturation without specifying how the ±14 was obtained for this panel.
